changelog: CUMULATIVE MANIFEST — deliberate, not a mistake. Found while investigating why production showed the v3.21.8 Calculator fix only partially applied (available margin correct, balance label/value stale): updater.php's apply step does not replay version history — it fetches whichever version.json is current at GitHub HEAD and downloads only the files listed in THAT single manifest's own files array, then jumps local_version straight to it. Every release in this project has followed the 'only list files that changed in this specific release' convention (v3.21.7's own files array, for example, listed pages/calculator.php and js/calculator.js — but v3.21.8's did not, since nothing in those two files changed in v3.21.8 specifically). A server whose own Update Now click lands on a later manifest without ever having separately applied an intermediate one silently never receives that intermediate release's files — permanently, since no later manifest repeats them unless they happen to change again.

Audited every version manifest from v3.20.3 (the last version this project's own CLAUDE.md had actually recorded as 'current' before its own version-tracking went stale — see that file's v3.21.7 note) through v3.21.8 (this release's immediate predecessor). Cross-checked the resulting union against a direct `git diff --stat` between the same two points as an independent integrity check, not just trusting the manifests' own bookkeeping: the two lists matched exactly, 20 files, no gaps and no extras. Per file, which release first introduced it: css/style.css (v3.20.10), includes/backtest_engine.php (v3.20.10), includes/controllers/BacktestController.php (v3.20.6), includes/controllers/BacktestDrawingController.php (v3.21.0), includes/controllers/CalculatorController.php (v3.21.7), includes/controllers/ReportCardController.php (v3.21.8), includes/helpers.php (v3.21.8), includes/router.php (v3.20.6), index.php (v3.20.9), js/app.js (v3.20.11), js/backtest-drawings.js (v3.21.0), js/backtest.js (v3.20.5), js/calculator.js (v3.21.7), js/chart.js (v3.21.4), js/saved-backtests.js (v3.20.5), migrations/2026_09_26_0001_add_backtest_rewind_support.sql (v3.20.10), migrations/2026_09_26_0002_add_backtest_cursor_step_tf.sql (v3.20.11), migrations/2026_09_26_0003_create_backtest_drawings.sql (v3.21.0), pages/backtest.php (v3.20.6), pages/calculator.php (v3.21.7).

This release's own files array below is that full 20-file union, not a diff of what changed since v3.21.8 — deliberately, so the next Update Now click (regardless of which version the live server is actually sitting on right now, which wasn't confirmed before this release shipped — see CLAUDE.md) re-downloads everything in the audited range in one pass. Re-downloading a file whose content is already current on the server is a harmless no-op overwrite; the risk this release is guarding against is the opposite one. The three migration files are included so they land on disk for migrate.php to pick up — per standing instruction, migrate.php itself was NOT run as part of this turn, and none of these files were deployed by this session either.

No code changed in this release beyond version.json/CLAUDE.md themselves — every file in the union already carries its correct, current content from the releases that introduced it. This is a deploy-manifest correction, not a functional patch.
